heroe.introDescription: I design and build custom web applications, from gathering requirements to production. On the back end, I build solid APIs with Laravel and Spring Boot; on the front end, I bring interfaces to life with Vue.js, React and Tailwind CSS. What interests me is the problem behind the project: understanding the business, modelling the data, then shipping something simple to use and easy to maintain. Take a look at my work or drop by the blog, where I write about what I learn along the way.

about.title: About Me
about.description: Full-stack developer based in Cotonou. I turn business needs into reliable web applications, from the data model to the interface.
about.longDescription:
My name is Chrislain Avocegan. I'm a full-stack developer and systems analyst with a bachelor's degree in software engineering. My work rarely starts with code: it starts with a conversation, a business process to understand and data to model properly. Then comes the technical part — a structured API with Laravel or Spring Boot, a clear interface with Vue.js or React, and a database designed to last.

I currently work at WEBCOM SASU on the analysis, design and development of business applications, as well as their maintenance in production. Alongside that, I've supported small businesses and freelancers: stock management, e-commerce platforms with mobile money payments, marketing sites with a back office.

What I look for in a project is clarity: code the next developer can read, screens users understand without training, and technical choices I can explain in plain words. Away from the keyboard, I skate, I read, and I tinker with interfaces in Figma.
